Dr Jess Luo Jiahui has been awarded the Editors’ Choice Award for 2025 for her outstanding paper published in the international journal Teaching in Higher Education. Her paper, titled ‘How Does GenAI Affect Trust in Teacher-Student Relationships? Insights from Students’ Assessment Experiences’, was selected by the journal’s executive editorial team as the best among seven nominated papers. Dr LUO, Jiahui Jess Assistant Professor, Department of Education Policy and Leadership
